description: Lists the spot bitcoin funds and the bitcoin each states it holds, as read from the fund's own SEC filing (10-Q or 10-K), its daily holdings file, or its periodic report, each figure with its date, its source and a quote. A fund's headline is its latest-dated figure; the other figures are served beside it. Custodians and the fund's lending statement are quoted as filed; "lending not stated" means no statement was found, not that the fund lends. A fund without a figure says why, never zero. Fund shares held by another fund or a public body are listed and not added, so each coin is counted once. Totals are given per date, and across dates only with the earliest and latest date they cover. Funds are listed by name; nothing is ranked. Returns the route's payload as served.
name: get_fund_holdings
title: Bitcoin held by spot funds
